title: Lithography
summary: LITHOG'RAPHY, noun [Gr. stone, and to engrave or write.] The art of engraving, or of tracing letters, figures or other designs on stone, and of transferring them to paper by impression; an art recentl

inlines.v: LITHOG'RAPHY, noun [Gr. stone, and to engrave or write.] The art of engraving, or of tracing letters, figures or other designs on stone, and of transferring them to paper by impression; an art recently invented by Mr. Sennefelder of Munich, in Bavaria.
